svg.text: Hybrid / Parallel Symbolic Execution Showcase Case Registry
Measured cases, available local candidates, and literature-backed integration targets for the current SymCC parallel framework.
A. Confirmed local positives
synthetic-parallel_scaling
parallel task dispatch and worker scaling
np16 vs np2: +27.1% relative edge coverage, 2.76x candidates
gfts-xml_read_fuzzer
public XML parser with structured paths
seed to np16: 2310 -> 3441 edges; np2 to np16: +331 edges
B. Confirmed hybrid and SOTA orchestration cases
lava-base64
precise value constraints, symbolic-heavy hybrid
hybrid 230 edges vs AFL-only 153 edges, +50.3% relative
pcre2-pcre2_fuzzer
persistent-aware gating and AFL++ profile orchestration
tuned hybrid 50.20% vs legacy 47.01%, AFL execs 2.28M -> 21.58M
libarchive-archive_fuzzer
real parser weak positive, persistent gating ablation
tuned hybrid 20.94% vs AFL-only 20.87%; old forced data map 13.46%
C. Local candidates and boundary cases
gfts-png_read_fuzzer
25s weak positive: hybrid 569 edges vs AFL-only 510
sqlite-sqlite_fuzzer
available; use SQL grammar/dictionary and AUC
freetype2-freetype2_fuzzer
available; seed stratification needed
jhead-jhead
available; fix solver assertion and run 10min/1h
lava-md5sum / uniq / who
available; use bug oracle rather than edge coverage
D. Literature-backed integration queue
tcpdump
S2F highlights strong hybrid over pure fuzzing signal
binutils: readelf/nm/objdump/strip
CoFuzz, Pangolin, S2F; ELF multi-layer parser
bento / Bento4
CoFuzz and Pangolin strong MP4 structure target
pngfix / pngimage, openjpeg, libjpeg, libtiff
image parsers; comparison/data coverage ablations
Magma and FuzzBench expansion
ground-truth and standardized long-run metrics
Use measured cases for current reporting; use candidates for the next long-run matrix. Do not merge literature results into local measured claims.
